intro: Keep Streamer.bot commands and Twitch rewards usable only on the scenes you choose. On the wrong scene a command is turned off and a Twitch reward is hidden; when the stream ends everything is turned back on.

sections.title: 1. Gates
sections.description: One row per command or reward, with the scenes where it may be used.
sections.notice: Pick a Streamer.bot command (refresh the Streamer.bot list first) or paste a Twitch reward ID (right-click the reward in Streamer.bot and choose Copy Reward Id). Kick rewards cannot be turned off by Streamer.bot: add a Check only row, then put Set Argument gateId (the gate name) and Run Action THSV Scene Gate - Check at the top of the Kick action. Separate scenes with commas.

sections.title: 2. When gates apply
sections.description: Live-only gating and the reply viewers see on the wrong scene.
